author: 24LopezR
body:
#### PR description:

This PR modifies the newly introduced SoA formats for MTD RecHits (see PR #51861). In particular it replaces the DetId field with a uint32_t field for the raw DetId number. The reason is that the DetId field causes -Wclass-memaccess warnings at compilation time (see issue https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52456)

This PR attempts to fix issue https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52456

#### PR validation:

This PR has been validated locally with workflow 34434.0 TTbar_14TeV_TuneCP5_Run4D121.
No compilation errors or warnigs were observed.
